# Blue Ocean Hub: Full Plaintext Financial Archive

> South Asia's premier financial magazine and intelligence publication. Delivering elite cashflow allocation, personal wealth building, and international currency hedging blueprints for founders, freelancers, and entrepreneurs.

## Core Categories

- [Passive Income](https://blueoceanhub.info/passive-income) - High-yield cashflow, real estate REITs, and digital assets
- [Investing](https://blueoceanhub.info/investing) - PSX equities, mutual funds, Sukuk bonds, and commodities
- [Freelancing](https://blueoceanhub.info/freelancing) - Technical agency scaling, enterprise client acquisition, and USD contracts
- [Saving Money](https://blueoceanhub.info/saving-money) - FBR tax deductions, wealth statements, and provident fund optimization
- [Dollar Earning](https://blueoceanhub.info/dollar-earning) - Onshore business structures, global payroll, and foreign remittance channels
